edition.locus: Logos 21 opening: Heb 3 — apostle and high priest; Son not made

source_text: ΛΟΓΟΣ ΚΑ. pass_b_english: Twenty-first discourse. On “consider the apostle and high priest of our confession,” gathering that the Son is neither made nor a creature. If the Son were a product he would be numbered with all things; yet all things came to be through him, so he is not his own product.
notes: No Greystone; Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify
